analysis.reasonEn: Closed lower for 4 consecutive trading days, current price at 1,605,000 KRW. RSI at 43.7, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen at -13,087.1262. ADX at 9.6, indicating a non-trending market. Current price is 3.9x the 52-week low. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 1.24, suggesting normal trading activity. 52-week position at 46.5% indicates a neutral range. With 5 consecutive daily bearish candles, no attractive entry point for buyers is yet confirmed. Support near the lower Bollinger Band at 1,670,335 KRW needs to be observed. While a technical bounce is possible after 5 days of decline, a trend reversal signal is unconfirmed, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
